hero.badge: The Alibaba of packaging in Egypt
hero.lead: We manufacture and print bags, sacks, cartons and labels from our workshop in Mohandessin, Giza. No importing from China, no middlemen — we design it, print it, and ship it anywhere in Egypt and the Arab world.
hero.art_alt: Printed packaging produced by Media Print Pack

prod.h2: One workshop, every kind of packaging
prod.lead: From a zipper bag for a spice brand to five-ply corrugated cartons for a shipping line — printed, finished and delivered by the same team.

zipper.d: Zipper bags made plain or printed in one or two colours, in every size, as a single layer or two-ply lamination.

sacks.d: High-quality printed paper sacks in three plies, with an optional inner plastic layer — and we take small runs.

apparel.d: Clear polyester garment bags with a frosted 3-mil zip lock, resealable and quick to pack — no extra tape or materials needed.

nonwoven.d: Sturdy fabric totes sized for shopping, storage and giveaways — completely food-safe and reusable.

courier.d: Shipping bags in a strong material with a reliable seal, and a front pouch for the shipping label.

paperbags.d: Paper carriers in coated or kraft stock, printed or plain, finished to match your brand.

cartons.d: Printed boxes for cosmetics and retail products, finished so the pack earns its place on the shelf.

corrugated.d: Treated kraft board that protects the product in transit — three or five plies.

tags.d: Card stock in several weights, punched with string, printed one or two sides.

alu.d: Three-side seal pouches for coffee, supplements and dry food. Printed or plain.

stickers.d: Printed adhesive stickers turn any surface into brand space — for packs, products and sealing.

sacks5.d: Two-ply sacks for fertilisers, pesticides, coffee, supplements, clothing and chemicals — with a zip, a base and gussets.
sacks5.s1: Printed up to 2 colours from 300 sacks
sacks5.s2: Plain from 100 sacks (black, white, yellow, green, red)

why.h2: Fewer people between you and the finished box
why.lead: From the first sample to the pallet leaving our door, this is what actually changes when the workshop printing your packaging is the one that made it.

3.d: Printed bags start at 1,000 and printed sacks at 300 — you do not have to commit to a container to get your own packaging.

1.d: Design, printing and finishing happen in the same place, so nobody can pass the blame and nothing gets lost between suppliers.

2.d: You see and approve a physical sample before we produce the quantity. What you sign off on is what you get.

4.d: We ship to every governorate in Egypt, and to the Arab countries.

clients.h2: Brands that already print with us
clients.lead: From multinationals to growing local labels — a selection of the names we have produced packaging and print for.

proc.h2: Four steps from enquiry to delivery

1.d: Message us on WhatsApp or call with the type of packaging, the sizes and roughly how many you want.

2.d: Our team prepares the artwork, or reviews and print-proofs the design you already have.

3.d: We produce a sample. You check the material, the colours and the finish, then approve it.

4.d: The run is produced and shipped to your door anywhere in Egypt or the Arab world.

ind.lead: If your product needs to sit on a shelf, survive a courier, or carry your name — we have probably packed something like it.

srv.lead: The same press that prints your packaging handles the rest of your printed material.

extra.d: Professional design, a sample before final production, and shipping to Egypt's governorates and the Arab countries.

metalize.d: Strong-adhesive metalized stickers for polyethylene and polypropylene packs.

notepad.d: Every size, made to your specification, printed inside in up to four colours.

rollup.d: Roll-up banners for exhibitions, showrooms and points of sale.

letterhead.d: Company stationery and notebooks, consistent with the rest of your identity.

sticker.d: Stickers on paper or plastic stock, for large runs and short ones alike.

duplex.d: Printed duplex board boxes, sized and finished around the product they hold.

flyer.d: Marketing print produced at high quality, in the quantity you actually need.

promo.d: Branded giveaway bags carrying your logo, for events and campaigns.
